modpack.stage.survival_age.description: Build a home, fields, and a kitchen to supply your first factory.
modpack.stage.mechanical_age.description: Connect pipes, conveyors, and basic smelting into your first production lines.
modpack.stage.electric_age.description: Use industrial circuits, power, and ore processing to support automation and basic defenses.
modpack.stage.information_age.descriptio: Build digital storage and autocrafting to keep complex logistics manageable.
modpack.stage.heavy_industry_age.descrip: Expand heavy machinery, automated mines, and defenses to supply materials in bulk.
modpack.stage.atomic_age.description: Master nuclear power, iridium, and nanomaterials for spaceflight and quantum industry.
modpack.stage.space_age.description: Extend Earth industry into orbit and onto other worlds with reliable colonial outposts.
modpack.stage.quantum_age.description: Build quantum equipment and large industrial networks. This stage can be reached entirely on Earth.
modpack.route.industry.title: Industrial Engineering
modpack.route.industry.description: Supply power, circuits, and advanced materials to keep industry running.
modpack.route.automation.title: Automation and Logistics
modpack.route.automation.description: Connect resources, machines, and demand so supplies arrive when needed.
modpack.route.military.title: Base Defense
modpack.route.military.description: Plan defenses and firepower, then keep them supplied to protect industry and homes.
modpack.route.space.title: Spaceflight and Colonization
modpack.route.space.description: Plan flights, oxygen, and supplies to turn distant outposts into reliable production bases.
modpack.route.exploration.title: Exploration
modpack.route.exploration.description: Investigate ruins and anomalies for resources, blueprints, and industrial shortcuts.
modpack.route.agriculture.title: Agriculture and Provisioning
modpack.route.agriculture.description: Supply food, crops, and biofuel to factories, defenses, and colonies.
modpack.route.building.title: Construction
modpack.route.building.description: Build factories, bases, and stations that are easy to expand, maintain, and defend.
modpack.quest.ic2_generator.title: Your First Industrial Power Supply
modpack.quest.ic2_generator.description: Prepare a basic circuit, a generator, and safe wiring. Run one machine reliably before expanding the grid. Equipment is not submitted or consumed.
modpack.quest.ore_processing.title: Get More from Every Ore
modpack.quest.ore_processing.description: Feed mined resources into industrial processing and collect primary products and byproducts separately. Check for blocked inputs and ensure dust is not reprocessed as raw ore.
modpack.quest.nuclear_grid.title: Power for Large Industry
modpack.quest.nuclear_grid.description: Plan the reactor, cooling, isolation, and backup power. Test shutdowns and failures before connecting essential production lines.
modpack.quest.earth_quantum.title: Quantum Industry on Earth
modpack.quest.earth_quantum.description: Refine your first iridium on Earth, then establish UU-Matter scanning and replication. Quantum control assemblies require neither alien resources nor boss drops.
modpack.quest.physical_logistics.title: From Chests to Production Lines
modpack.quest.physical_logistics.descrip: Use drawers and versatile storage for bulk ore, ingots, parts, and crops, then connect machines with pipes or conveyors. Plan overflow handling and stop signals before increasing transport speed.
modpack.quest.ae2_bootstrap.title: Start Your First Digital Warehouse
modpack.quest.ae2_bootstrap.description: Power an inscriber independently to make processors, then let the digital network take over existing physical warehouses through storage buses. Presses can be manufactured on Earth and meteorites are an optional shortcut; drawers and stockrooms keep their value.
modpack.quest.stock_control.title: Produce to Stock Targets
modpack.quest.stock_control.description: Aggregate physical inventory through a storage controller, then set restocking thresholds for circuits, ammunition, and food. Prioritize essential supplies and plan for full storage, power loss, and missing ingredients.
modpack.quest.remote_supply.title: Connect Remote Bases
modpack.quest.remote_supply.description: Link powered, loaded networks with a quantum bridge and keep local supply buffers. A disconnected base should still sustain essential operations.
modpack.quest.layered_defense.title: Your First Defensive Line
modpack.quest.layered_defense.descriptio: Start with lighting, terrain, and safe paths. Build outer and inner lines with room to retreat, patrol, resupply, and repair.
modpack.quest.first_turret.title: Keep Your Turret Supplied
modpack.quest.first_turret.description: Deploy a basic turret and check power, ammunition, and friendly targets. Test its coverage in a small drill and spread out your reserves.
modpack.quest.combined_fire.title: Match Firepower to the Enemy
modpack.quest.combined_fire.description: Use machine guns against ordinary targets, area fire against crowds, and heavy firepower against armored units. Coordinate firing lanes and supplies across weapon types.
modpack.quest.defense_drill.title: Hold the Base During a Supply Failure
modpack.quest.defense_drill.description: Drill a power-grid or transport failure. Check that oxygen, basic firepower, and food reserves remain available, and record actual consumption during each defense.
modpack.quest.launch_preparation.title: Industrial Preparation for Launch
modpack.quest.launch_preparation.descrip: Produce aerospace materials and a control core on Earth. Prepare fuel, oxygen, food, and return reserves. Verify supplies before scheduling your first flight.
modpack.quest.first_launch.title: From the Factory to the Moon
modpack.quest.first_launch.description: Bring startup power, oxygen equipment, and building materials to establish a lunar outpost with a safe return plan. Alien mining improves efficiency but is not required for Earth technology.
modpack.quest.orbital_station.title: Build an Orbital Hub
modpack.quest.orbital_station.descriptio: Build a safe station for storage, research, and transfers. Enemies do not appear by default, but oxygen and power are still required. Special events only occur when explicitly enabled.
modpack.quest.colony_network.title: Make Colonies Self-Sufficient
modpack.quest.colony_network.description: Give each outpost local storage, power, greenhouses, and defenses. Specialize by planetary strengths and account for transport and defense costs before expanding.
modpack.quest.survey.title: Survey with a Purpose
modpack.quest.survey.description: Record ore sites, routes, terrain, and potential outposts. Surveys help engineers and builders choose locations without requiring combat.
modpack.quest.ruin_salvage.title: Turn Ruins into Industrial Shortcuts
modpack.quest.ruin_salvage.description: Recover useful materials, presses, and blueprints. They save industrial investment, while equivalent essential functions retain deterministic manufacturing routes.
modpack.quest.optional_boss.title: Challenge a Dangerous Ruin
modpack.quest.optional_boss.description: Choose whether to challenge a ruin boss. Prepare supplies and an escape route for valuable materials or special modules. Victory does not unlock required technology.
modpack.quest.anomaly_research.title: Investigate Alien Anomalies
modpack.quest.anomaly_research.descripti: Observe anomaly warnings before choosing to sample or withdraw. Process recovered materials through industrial and research facilities; keep unknown samples out of living quarters.
modpack.quest.base_kitchen.title: A Kitchen That Feeds the Base
modpack.quest.base_kitchen.description: Build fields, a cooking pot, and a shared kitchen with bowls and basic fuel. Make food easy for teammates to collect without repeatedly searching for ingredients.
modpack.quest.food_buffers.title: Deliver the Harvest
modpack.quest.food_buffers.description: Connect farms, kitchens, and expedition supply chests. Keep staple reserves and check container returns and full storage to maintain reliable transport.
modpack.quest.fuel_crops.title: Food First, Surplus for Fuel
modpack.quest.fuel_crops.description: Support biofuel production with crops while reserving food and seeds first. Expand farming with industry so fuel production does not exhaust the food supply.
modpack.quest.planetary_greenhouse.title: Plant Your First Alien Greenhouse
modpack.quest.planetary_greenhouse.descr: Prepare sealing, oxygen, light, water, and backup power for a lunar or Martian farm. Verify environmental conditions and crop suitability before scaling up.
modpack.quest.factory_layout.title: Leave Room for the Factory to Grow
modpack.quest.factory_layout.description: Plan workshops, storage, service corridors, and maintenance access. Establish an expandable layout before adding finishes. No fixed block count is required.
modpack.quest.building_gadget.title: Build at Industrial Scale
modpack.quest.building_gadget.descriptio: Make a basic building gadget and stock power and materials. Test placement and undo in a small area before building factories and roads.
modpack.quest.industrial_district.title: Build a Maintainable Industrial District
modpack.quest.industrial_district.descri: Use steel frames, concrete, glass, and signs to organize power, production, and reserves. Preserve firing lanes and maintenance access; appearance does not replace real protection.
modpack.quest.colony_architecture.title: Build Habitats That Support Survival
modpack.quest.colony_architecture.descri: Separate living quarters, greenhouses, machinery, and quarantine areas. Provide clear routes and emergency reserves. Verify actual sealing rather than trusting a glass appearance.
modpack.item.engineering_assembly.toolti: A starting component for mechanical engineering, crafted by hand from basic Earth materials.
modpack.item.information_interface.toolt: Connects industrial electronics with digital logistics. Manufacturing it requires no existing digital network.
modpack.item.heavy_industry_control.tool: Used in large production machines, engineering miners, and heavy defenses.
modpack.item.reactor_control.tooltip: A control component for atomic industry. Complete bench and backup-power tests first.
modpack.item.space_control_core.tooltip: Combines industrial circuits, heavy structures, and aerospace materials. Can be manufactured on Earth.
modpack.item.colony_maintenance.tooltip: For colony repairs and supplies. Consult the relevant facility instructions for supported uses.
modpack.item.quantum_control.tooltip: Used in quantum equipment and large logistics systems. Requires no boss drops or alien-exclusive materials.
modpack.item.anomaly_analysis.tooltip: Processes anomaly research findings and can also be manufactured through Earth industry.
modpack.planet.earth.name: Earth
modpack.planet.earth.description: The starting point of industrial civilization. A complete basic resource base supports quantum industry, while mixed hordes test defenses and logistics.
modpack.planet.moon.name: Moon
modpack.planet.moon.description: Rich resources and sparse enemies. Teleporting individuals and ruin guardians test layered defenses, while sealing and oxygen remain essential.
modpack.planet.mars.name: Mars
modpack.planet.mars.description: Dense, fast-moving swarms threaten colonial outposts. Area firepower, ammunition reserves, and protected greenhouses sustain production.
modpack.planet.venus.name: Venus
modpack.planet.venus.description: Mixed hostile populations and harsh conditions apply pressure together. Zoned power, reliable oxygen, and varied firepower support a resilient colony.
modpack.planet.mercury.name: Mercury
modpack.planet.mercury.description: Vast and quiet, with rare anomalies and dangerous individuals. Watch for warnings and prepare escape routes for valuable salvage.
modpack.planet.glacio.name: Glacio
modpack.planet.glacio.description: Sparse large creatures carry heavy armor. Wide firing lanes, armor-piercing firepower, and reliable life support suit colonies here.
modpack.planet.station.name: Space Station
modpack.planet.station.description: A safe orbital hub by default, with no natural hostile spawns or periodic hordes. Special events must be explicitly enabled; oxygen and power still need upkeep.
modpack.message.horde_warning: %1$s: a horde is expected in %2$s seconds. Check defenses and supplies.
modpack.message.horde_started: %1$s: the horde has arrived. Watch every defensive line.
modpack.message.horde_ended: %1$s: the attack has ended. Restock ammunition and inspect damaged facilities.
modpack.message.horde_deferred: %1$s: the attack has been deferred. A new warning will be issued in advance.
modpack.message.recovery_period: %1$s: %2$s minutes of recovery remain. No new base attack will begin during this period.
modpack.message.low_ammo: %1$s: ammunition reserves are low. Restock or adjust firepower.
modpack.message.low_power: %1$s: power is low. Prioritize oxygen and essential defenses.
modpack.message.low_oxygen: %1$s: oxygen reserves are low. Check power, oxygen supply, and compartment sealing.
modpack.message.supply_interrupted: %1$s: the supply link is interrupted. Local reserves are in use.
modpack.message.supply_restored: %1$s: the supply link has been restored.
modpack.message.station_event_warning: %1$s: a special event will begin in the quarantine zone in %2$s seconds. Leave the danger area.
modpack.message.station_event_ended: %1$s: the special event has ended. Normal station controls have resumed.
modpack.message.boss_detected: Dangerous individual detected: %1$s. You may engage or withdraw.
modpack.message.base_registered: Base %1$s has been registered. Industrial activity will be measured from local facilities.
modpack.message.threat_changed: %1$s: local threat is now %2$s. See base status for details.
modpack.message.manufacturing_denied: The owning team has not mastered %1$s. Manufacturing is paused.
modpack.message.return_reserve: Return reserves are low. Replenish fuel, oxygen, and food.
modpack.gui.safe_station: Safe by default; special events are disabled
modpack.gui.recipe_locked: Manufacturing is not yet available. You can still review ingredients and route guidance.
modpack.tutorial.team_progression: Teams share manufacturing research, while individuals may specialize. Buying a finished product does not grant manufacturing knowledge. The quest book provides guidance.
modpack.tutorial.earth_alternative: Most basic resources and all required advanced materials are obtainable on Earth. Colonization saves materials and energy, and exploration provides shortcuts; neither is mandatory for industrial progress.
modpack.tutorial.power_priority: Prioritize oxygen, emergency batteries, and basic defenses before kitchens and production. Separate essential facilities from heavy loads and maintain local reserves for outages.
modpack.tutorial.ae2_bootstrap: Run the inscriber on independent power first and make processors before the controller. The digital network reads drawers and storage controllers through storage buses; pipes and conveyors still carry bulk transport while the digital layer schedules and crafts.
modpack.tutorial.safe_station: Stations have no hostile spawns by default but still require life support. Only explicitly enabled special events may create enemies. Keep quarantine areas separate from living quarters.
modpack.tutorial.kitchen_automation: The kitchen provides shared ingredients, while cooking pots prepare supported dishes. Verify input sides, output sides, bowls, and fuel handling before automating restocking. Reserve food before turning surplus crops into fuel.
modpack.tutorial.horde_engineers: Engineers can remove obstacles or build paths within limits. Use layered defenses, clear firing lanes, and repair reserves, and prioritize units opening routes.
modpack.tutorial.storage_progression: After chests and barrels, use drawers and versatile storage for bulk materials. Capacity, filtering, and compression upgrades open with the Electrical Age and consume industrial components. A digital network reads existing warehouses instead of replacing them.
modpack.tutorial.backpack_kit: Backpacks serve mining, engineering, exploration, expeditions, and colony construction. Basic packs open early; capacity, pickup, and resupply upgrades unlock by stage. A backpack is not factory logistics or a portable crafting network.
modpack.tutorial.unified_oil: Oil fields feed one unified chain through pipes: petroleum refining, electrical control, and heavy processing produce fuels and chemicals for power, defense, and spaceflight. Both oil systems must share the same fluids and tags.
modpack.boss.ruin_guardian.name: Ruin Guardian
modpack.boss.ruin_guardian.warning: The ruin guardian has been alerted. Keep an escape route open and watch its attack cues.
modpack.boss.mercury_anomaly.name: Mercury Anomaly
modpack.boss.mercury_anomaly.warning: Anomalous activity is intensifying. Check supplies and an escape route before approaching.
modpack.boss.glacio_colossus.name: Glacio Colossus
modpack.boss.glacio_colossus.warning: A large target is approaching. Prepare armor-piercing firepower and avoid its frontal charge.
